Class PurchaseOrderBuilderController

public without sharing class PurchaseOrderBuilderController

Apex controller for the purchaseOrderBuilder LWC component. Provides methods for retrieving product, vendor, and venue details, creating vendor catalog products, and saving purchase orders with their line items in a single transaction. Unlike the quote builder, purchase orders do not use price books — unit prices are entered directly.

@AuraEnabled
public static PurchaseOrderBuilderController.ProductSearchResult createProduct(
  String productName,
  String productCode,
  Decimal vendorPrice,
  String description,
  Id vendorId
)

Creates a new Product2 record with the VendorCatalogItem record type, associated to the given vendor, and returns the product details.

Parameters:
    productName – The name of the product to create.
    productCode – The product code.
    vendorPrice – The vendor price for the product.
    description – The product description.
    vendorId – The Id of the vendor Account to associate.

Returns:
    ProductSearchResult: The created product details.

public static PurchaseOrderBuilderController.ProductSearchResult getProductDetails(Id productId)

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static Map<String, String> getVendorDetails(Id vendorId)

Retrieves vendor details including point of contact name and email for a given Account Id. Used to auto-populate vendor information when a vendor is selected.

Parameters:
    vendorId – The Id of the vendor Account record.

Returns:
    Map<String, String>: Map with vendor detail keys.

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static Map<String, String> getVenueDetails(Id venueId)

Retrieves venue address details for a given Account Id. Returns the shipping address if populated, otherwise falls back to the billing address. The address is formatted as a multi-line string for use in the shipping address field.

Parameters:
    venueId – The Id of the venue Account record.

Returns:
    Map<String, String>: Map with shippingAddress key containing the formatted address.
